premises.text: Meeting people in online gaming is difficult and often anonymous
premises.evidence_span: If you think meeting a girl in a sports bar is difficult, try playing a girl on Halo on Xbox Live. Nearly impossible.

premises.text: Game Crush provides a platform for social interaction in gaming
premises.evidence_span: Game Crush offers something completely different. We offer rich user profiles, deep engagements with other users, including profiles that include blogs, pictures, and you're able to chat online.

premises.text: Users can earn money while playing games on the platform
premises.evidence_span: The payer, as we call it, pays, and the play date actually makes money playing that game.

premises.text: The platform allows for greater control over the gaming environment
premises.evidence_span: It offers greater control of your environment and monetarily addresses the issues of supply and demand.

premises.text: Game Crush has gained a user base without paid advertising
premises.evidence_span: we amassed 10,000 users without paying a penny in advertising.

value.text: Game Crush creates a fun and inviting social gaming environment
value.evidence_span: we are a fun, inviting place to play.

notes: Beta status and user count are included as evidence of traction.
